description: The Risk Radar from The 07:00 Brief: the ranked risks being watched, each with its theme, trend, impact, probability, summary, the indicator to watch, what it would mean for portfolios, when it was first seen and on how many mornings it has appeared. The latest radar also gives when tracking began, how many mornings have been read and how many risks have been tracked. Without a date it is the latest radar; with date (YYYY-MM-DD) it is the radar published that day.
name: get_risk_radar
title: Get risk radar
